description: Get information about the current Dropbox account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the account object (account_id, name, email, email_verified, country, locale, account_type, is_paired, disabled); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List the contents of a folder at the given path.

path.description: Optional folder path to list; empty or '/' lists the root.

recursive.description: Optional flag; when true, list all descendants recursively (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has entries (file/folder metadata), cursor, and has_more; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Download the text content of a file at the given Dropbox path (or file id). Only text-like and PDF files are downloadable.

path.description: The Dropbox path (e.g. '/documents/roadmap.md') or file id to download.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes file_id, name, path_display, mime_type, size_bytes, and content (extracted text). On failure (not found, folder, unsupported mime, or PDF text unavailable), output contains an error object.

description: Get metadata for a file or folder by its path or id.

path.description: The path or id of the file or folder.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the file/folder metadata entry; on failure (path not found), output contains an error object.

description: Search for files and folders by filename, optionally scoped to a path.

query.description: Optional search query matched against file names (case-insensitive substring).

path.description: Optional path to scope the search to; empty searches the whole account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has matches (each with match_type and metadata) and has_more; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List shared links, optionally filtered to a single path.

path.description: Optional path to filter shared links by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has links (each with url, name, path_lower, link_permissions) and has_more; on failure, output contains an error message.
